headline: Kai, Nvidia grew 106% and promised $108 billion more; the last word this week still belongs to Warsh.
subline: The beat lifts futures, July PCE stayed stuck at 3.7%, and Kyiv spent the night under a rare hours-long aerial attack.
asof: Pre-market · Thursday ~6:40 AM ET · index rows are overnight futures; yield and gold at Wednesday's settle · every figure links to a source below

items.title: Nvidia: a $96.2 billion quarter, a $108 billion guide
items.sentence: Revenue rose 106% to $96.2 billion with data-center sales of $89.0 billion and gross margin at 75.0%, and Nvidia guided the October quarter to $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, per the company's release.

items.title: Futures firm behind the beat
items.sentence: S&P 500 futures rose 0.34% to 7,716.50 overnight, Nasdaq 100 futures gained 0.64% to 29,477.75 and Dow futures added 0.33% to 53,642.30, per Investing.com's futures boards.

items.title: July PCE holds at 3.7%; core stalls at 3.3%
items.sentence: Wednesday's report ran firmer than forecast — headline PCE flat at 3.7% year over year and core at 3.3% against expectations near 3.2% — an uncomfortable backdrop for a Fed about to speak, per NCH Stats.

items.title: Today: claims, goods trade, KC Fed; Warsh tomorrow
items.sentence: Weekly jobless claims, advance goods trade and wholesale inventories land at 8:30 a.m. with the Kansas City Fed survey at 11, per Kiplinger's calendar, before Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's 10 a.m. Jackson Hole keynote on Friday.

items.title: Wednesday: chips led, confidence sagged
items.sentence: The S&P 500 closed up 0.3% at 7,677.24 and the Nasdaq rose 0.7% as chipmakers rallied into the print, while the 10-year slid to settle at 4.625%, gold eased 0.83% to $4,655.50 and consumer confidence hit a seven-month low of 89.4, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Bitcoin holds $79,000 after the squeeze
items.sentence: Bitcoin settled Wednesday at $79,027, up 0.59%, still riding the squeeze that liquidated more than $1.4 billion in bearish bets and briefly carried it above $80,000, per The Rio Times.

items.title: Hours-long Russian aerial attack rocks Kyiv overnight
items.sentence: Jet-powered drones and ballistic missiles struck the capital into Thursday morning, with Ukraine's Air Force reporting seven Iskander-M or KN-23 missiles intercepted, per the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: Canada's tariffs on $20 billion of US goods bite
items.sentence: Ottawa's retaliatory duties on nearly $20 billion of US goods moved ahead as businesses on both sides of the border absorb the uncertainty, per NPR's Morning Edition.

items.title: Hormuz diplomacy keeps Brent pinned near $88
items.sentence: Brent sat at $88.03, up 0.22% and 29.5% in a year, as Iran and Oman advanced a Strait of Hormuz arrangement — Trump said 10 million barrels transited Tuesday — and US sanctions on Iran landed lighter than feared, per Trading Economics.

items.title: Lukoil refineries go dark after Ukrainian strikes
items.sentence: Russia's second-largest gasoline producer suspended oil processing again, leaving all major Lukoil refineries in Russia offline, per the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: CIA chief warned Moscow off the Baltics
items.sentence: John Ratcliffe used a Moscow visit to warn against escalation toward NATO's Baltic members, the Kyiv Independent reports, citing Politico.

items.title: Kress calls fiscal 2028: 70% growth, supply-constrained
items.sentence: Nvidia dipped 1.3% on the print and recovered to roughly +5% after CFO Colette Kress guided fiscal 2028 to 70% revenue growth she called supply-constrained, with backlog above $2 trillion and first Rubin shipments expected in Q3, per Kiplinger.

items.title: DeepMind's grip on elite AI talent slips
items.sentence: Zeki Data shows DeepMind's share of Europe's elite research hires falling from 49% in 2022-23 to 18.6% in 2025-26, with a quarter of departing staff landing at Anthropic, per Fortune.

items.title: Meta settles the teen case for $16.68 billion
items.sentence: The settlement — up to $16.68 billion, plus two-hour daily caps and a midnight-to-6 a.m. lockout for under-18 accounts — resolves the states' social-media addiction case that went to trial this month, per TechStartups.

items.title: Anthropic shops a $2 trillion IPO pitch
items.sentence: The company is pitching an IPO on a claimed $30-trillion-plus addressable market and a valuation target near $2 trillion, per TechStartups, while SoftBank explores a $10–20 billion bond sale to refinance its $40 billion OpenAI bridge loan.
